info.name: Sockless Mail
info.summary: Serves the Sockless Mail External App at /apps/socklessmail/, installable as an app
info.description: A companion to the Sockless Mail External App (app id sockless_mail, deployed through AppAPI). It shows the same mail page at /apps/socklessmail/ instead of AppAPI's /apps/app_api/embedded/sockless_mail/sockless_mail and points the Sockless Mail entry of the app menu there. From that address the browser can install it as an app (named and pictured like the External App), which then shows the unread count on its icon. Everything else, including the mail page itself, still comes from the External App.
info.author: Jimmy Everling
